items.name: 樱溪浅梦
items.prompt: Edit the referenced aquarium game background into a completely new purchasable environment in the SAME clean Japanese fantasy anime game illustration style: controlled cel-like shapes, luminous clear water, readable silhouettes, delicate outlines, polished 2D painted scene, not photographic or 3D. Deliver ONE landscape full-bleed background, exactly 16:10 aspect ratio, preferably 1536x960. Underwater camera looking slightly down across a wide flat pale substrate. Water occupies the entire image, NO above-water sky or landscape view. Preserve the functional composition: bottom 22% a continuous calm flat open placement floor, middle 60% mostly empty clear swimming space, thematic scenery restricted to outer edges and distant backdrop, soft upper water-surface caustics. No fish, creatures, people, UI, frame, glass tank rim, text, logo, watermarks, floating foreground debris, bubbles drawn as white circles, or large center obstacle. It must accept 12 independently animated colorful fish and separate user-placeable decor without visual clutter. Change the actual terrain silhouettes and palette, not just recolor existing ruins. Theme: Sakura spring creek, jade-mint and pale aquamarine water with warm blush-pink reflected illumination. Delicate SUBMERGED twisting roots, pale smooth river stones and small clusters of soft pink aquatic leaves at far left and right. Faint distant root terraces framing an empty central sandy clearing. Tiny sparse petal-like aquatic leaves may sit at the very margins, never shower across the center. Gentle sunlit romantic spring morning. Natural freshwater scenery, NO architecture, no torii, no literal cherry trees growing across the middle, no sky.
